title: 第1章 活活打死第2章 万年以后
content_zh:
第1章活活打死
武盛国度，渭水河畔，三道身影相立而对。
其中两道身影，高达七尺，一身肌肉，高高隆起，一举一动之间，便是充满力量，一眼便足以看出，这是两位习武之人。
而这两道身影的面前，却是一名极为瘦弱的男子，在这两尊壮汉的衬托之下，更是显得极为单薄。
“小杂种，将这个月的俸禄乖乖交出来吧。”
其中一尊壮汉，看向站在对面瘦弱男子，嘴角露出几分不屑笑容道。
“就你一个没有灵脉的废物，拿这俸禄，也是白白浪费，还不快交出来！”
“绝无可能。”
男子虽瘦弱，但是他的神情却是极为坚毅，在他的手上，死死的抓着一枚玉瓶，在这玉瓶之中，三枚乳白色灵丹明晃晃的放在其中。
看到这三枚乳白色灵丹的一刻，两名壮汉的眼神之中，都露出了几分明晃晃的贪婪之色。
他们两人脚下不乏，也是逼近几步，如今面对着瘦弱男子，只有一步之遥。
瘦弱男子怒声训斥道。
“林莫！
林叶！
你们二人，不过是林府的外府奴才罢了，以下犯上，可是死罪！”
听到这一声训斥，那林莫，林叶二人先是一愣，随后便是大笑了起来道。
“楚风眠，你还真当你是林府的外府大管家了不成？就你一个没法修炼的废物，不过是靠着你死去的爷爷对林家的一点恩惠，才给了你一个外府大管家的位置。”
“乖乖的将每个月的俸禄交出来，我们二人还可以听你几分话，但若是你不交的话，也别怪我们二人硬抢了！”
林莫大笑道。
在这渭水河旁，四周无人，他们两人就算做什么，也没人能看见，再者说就算是被人看见，谁又敢来出手，得罪林府。

“小杂种！
快点将那三枚淬骨丹交出来吧。”
林叶逼近一步，冷声笑道。
“不然一会，你免不了一顿皮肉之苦。”
“绝无可能！”
楚风眠的眼神之中露出几分绝望之色，但是他紧握玉瓶的手，却是丝毫没有放松下来。
这淬骨丹，可是他最后修炼的希望，他又怎么可能把这三枚淬骨丹交给这二人。
“小杂种！
看来你真还是给脸不要脸了！”
听到楚风眠的回答，林莫，林叶二人的脸色都是阴沉了下来，在他们两人的嘴角，都能看出几分阴狠之色。
“既然如此，那也别怪我们二人不客气了！”
林莫脸色露出几分狰狞笑容，便是脚下一动，一出手便是对着楚风眠手中玉瓶抓了过去。
“拿来吧！”
看到林莫出手，楚风眠脸色一变，右手握拳，一拳轰然对着林莫打了出去。
“凌风拳！”
楚风眠的拳锋之上，一抹淡青色浮现而出，这正是灵力的表现。
在这武胜国度，所有习武之人，都修灵力，传闻灵力修大成者，足以翱翔天地，移山填海。
不过楚风眠现在这一拳的拳风之上，淡青色却是极为稀薄，这便是灵力不足的表现。
看到楚风眠的这一拳，林莫的脸色更是满是嘲讽笑容。
“果然是一个废物，就连最为下级的武技凌风拳都用不好，也该让你见识见识，什么是真正的武技！”

林莫眼神一边，他的身形瞬间变得轻盈起来。
一脚猛然对着楚风眠的胸口提了过去。
清风腿！
林府外院之中的中级武技，虽然说这林莫动用之时并不熟练，但是对楚风眠来说，却是如同灭顶之灾。
content_en:
Chapter 1 Beaten to death
In the Kingdom of Wusheng, on the banks of the Weishui River, three figures stood facing each other.
Two of the figures were seven feet tall. Their muscles were bulging high. Every move they made was full of power. It was enough to tell at a glance that they were two martial arts practitioners.
But in front of these two figures was an extremely thin man, who looked even more frail against the backdrop of these two strong men.
"You little bastard, please hand over this month's salary."
One of the strong men looked at the thin man standing opposite, with a disdainful smile on his lips.
"You are a waste without spiritual veins. This salary is wasted, why don't you hand it over quickly!"
"Absolutely impossible."
Although the man was thin, his expression was extremely determined. In his hand, he was clutching a jade bottle. In this jade bottle, three milky white elixirs were placed in it.
The moment they saw these three milky white elixirs, the eyes of the two strong men revealed a hint of greed.
The two of them had no shortage of feet, and they were also a few steps closer. Now they were facing the thin man, only one step away.
The thin man scolded angrily.
"Lin Mo!
Lin Ye!
You two are just servants of the Lin Mansion. Any of the following crimes will be punishable by death! "
Hearing this scolding, Lin Mo and Lin Ye were stunned for a moment, and then laughed.
"Chu Fengmian, do you really think that you are the Lin family's chief steward? You are a useless person who cannot practice cultivation, but it was only because of your dead grandfather's favor to the Lin family that you were given the position of the outer steward."
"Hand over your monthly salary obediently, and the two of us can still listen to you a little bit, but if you don't hand it over, don't blame the two of us for robbing it!"
Lin Mo laughed.
Beside the Weishui River, there was no one around. No matter what the two of them did, no one could see them. Furthermore, even if they were seen, who would dare to take action to offend the Lin family.
“Little bastard!
Hurry and hand over those three bone-tempering pills. "
Lin Ye took a step closer and laughed coldly.
"Otherwise, you will inevitably suffer a physical and mental torture in a while."
"Absolutely impossible!"
There was a hint of despair in Chu Fengmian's eyes, but his hand holding the jade bottle did not relax at all.
This Bone Tempering Pill was his last hope for cultivation, so how could he give these three Bone Tempering Pills to these two people.
“Little bastard!
It seems you are really shameless! "
After hearing Chu Fengmian's answer, Lin Mo and Lin Ye's expressions darkened, and a sinister look could be seen in the corners of their mouths.
"In that case, don't blame us two for being rude!"
Lin Mo had a ferocious smile on his face. He moved his feet and grabbed the jade bottle in Chu Fengmian's hand.
"Bring it here!"
Seeing Lin Mo take action, Chu Fengmian's expression changed. He made a fist with his right hand and punched Lin Mo with a bang.
"Ling Feng Fist!"
A touch of light cyan emerged from Chu Fengmian's fist, which was a manifestation of spiritual power.
In this martial arts country, all those who practice martial arts cultivate spiritual power. It is said that those who have achieved great spiritual power can soar through the sky and earth, move mountains and fill seas.
However, the light cyan color of Chu Fengmian's current punch was extremely thin, which was a sign of insufficient spiritual power.
Seeing Chu Fengmian's punch, Lin Mo's face was filled with a mocking smile.
"As expected, he is a waste. He can't even use Lingfeng Fist, the lowest level of martial arts. You should be shown what real martial arts are!"
Lin Mo looked aside, and his figure instantly became lighter.
A kick was suddenly lifted towards Chu Fengmian's chest.
Breeze legs!
Although Lin Mo was not proficient in the intermediate martial arts in the outer courtyard of the Lin Mansion, for Chu Fengmian, it was like a catastrophe.。
